summary.en-US: Fill CUIMS login details, solve the CAPTCHA on-device, skip promotional interstitials, hide event or feedback interruptions, and open a cleaner LMS course directory.

version.approval_notes: CUIMS Clear is an independent student utility. It stores credentials only in Firefox storage.local. CAPTCHA images are read on-device by the extension's own unminified JavaScript (captcha-solver.js), which matches the four characters against the glyphs of the fixed font CUIMS uses (captcha-glyphs.js, generated by scripts/build-captcha-glyphs.py in the source repository); no data is uploaded and no remote code is loaded at runtime. Since 0.8.6 there is no third-party or minified code in the package. Host access is limited to students.cuchd.in and lms.cuchd.in. The LMS launcher clicks the university's own CU LMS control and follows the LMS URL without saving it. The LMS directory may fetch additional same-origin /my/courses.php pages to pair syllabus and semester-work entries. Since 0.10.6 the background fetches https://addons.mozilla.org/api/v5/addons/addon/cuims-clear/ (credentials omitted, at most every six hours) to show a 'new version is out' notice; the Update link on CUIMS pages points at AMO's own latest.xpi, so Firefox's normal install prompts apply. The extension never registers runtime.onUpdateAvailable, so Firefox's own update handling is unchanged. Since 1.0 there is a 1.0 tab (a receipt of the extension's own counts, Proxy Run, a time capsule, Semester Wrapped), all on-device with no network requests. CUIMS's My Time Table, Datesheet and Marks View are redrawn on the page from their own data; Add to calendar builds an .ics file locally and hands it to Firefox's download. The Duty Leave page read now makes one same-origin postback to its External tab, where CUIMS moved the application history. No new permissions or hosts. Marks View is weighted on the device by marks-model.js; the popup's Marks tab reads the student's own frmStudentMarksView.aspx only when asked, through the same paced optional-page path. On the Duty Leave page, duty-leave.js clicks CUIMS's own External radio and, on the student's button press, fills CUIMS's own form fields (type, category, date, lecture checkboxes, count, Next Step) through CUIMS's own partial postbacks; it never presses Save or uploads a file.

release_notes.en-US: Marks are now weighted the way CU counts internal marks: each kind of assessment (MSTs, assignments, surprise tests, experiments) carries its CU share instead of the raw marks it was conducted for, so percentages match CU's. A new Marks tab in the popup shows your average, the raw total and every subject without opening CUIMS, and one switch decides whether Aptitude and Soft Skills count. Duty Leave on CUIMS opens straight on External, and a File duty leave card fills CUIMS's form (type, category, date, lectures, Next Step) from the classes you were marked absent in; the reason, proof and Save stay with you. No new permissions.
